{"claims":[{"claim_text":"America's leadership in life sciences R&D and medical innovation is being threatened.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"If the country does not work together, it will lose its leadership position in medical innovation, U.S. job creation, and access to life-saving treatments for U.S. patients.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States has led the global medical device and pharmaceutical industries for decades.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"This leadership has made the U.S. the medical innovation capital of the world, bringing millions of high-paying jobs to the country and life-saving devices and drugs to the nation's patients.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Patients, innovators, and job creators point to a lack of predictability, consistency, transparency and efficiency at the Food and Drug Administration that is driving innovation overseas, benefiting foreign, not U.S., patients.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to reform the FDA so the U.S. remains the world leader in medical innovation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to ensure device and drug jobs stay in the U.S.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to ensure U.S. patients benefit first from new devices and drugs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to prevent the FDA from wasting U.S. taxpayer and innovators' resources because of bureaucratic red tape and legal uncertainty.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Frivolous medical malpractice lawsuits have ballooned the cost of healthcare for the average American.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Physicians are increasingly practicing defensive medicine because of the looming threat of malpractice liability.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Some medical practitioners are avoiding patients with complex and high-risk medical problems because of the high costs of medical malpractice lawsuits.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Rural America is hurt especially hard as obstetricians, surgeons, and other healthcare providers are moving to urban settings or retiring, causing a significant healthcare workforce shortage and subsequently decreasing access to care for all patients.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to aggressively pursuing tort reform legislation to help avoid the practice of defensive medicine.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to keep healthcare costs low.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to improve healthcare quality.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Parents are responsible for the education of their children.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Support for providing broad education choices to parents and children at the State and local level.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Maintaining American preeminence requires a world-class system of education, with high standards, in which all students can reach their potential.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Today's education reform movement calls for accountability at every stage of schooling.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The education reform movement affirms higher expectations for all students and rejects the crippling bigotry of low expectations.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The education reform movement recognizes the wisdom of State and local control of schools.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The education reform movement sees consumer rights in education—choice—as the most important driving force for renewing schools.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
